candidates.label: A · Weightless pad

candidates.label: B · Silk glide
candidates.description: An unpitched fabric gesture, stretched into a fine, soft swish. No chord underneath.

candidates.label: C · Airy musical veil

candidates.provenance: Original Boundstoy composition and triangle/formant patch, rendered by Strudel. No external samples.
